list.description: Show only these clusters. All shows every GPU, including servers that are not in a cluster yet ('(no cluster)').
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(cluster, evidence ->> 'cluster', evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') AS cluster
FROM capacity_intervals
WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > now() - interval '30 days'
UNION
SELECT cluster FROM workloads_now
ORDER BY 1
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(cluster, evidence ->> 'cluster', evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') AS cluster
FROM capacity_intervals
WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > now() - interval '30 days'
UNION
SELECT cluster FROM workloads_now
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: GPUs wasted now
panels.description: GPUs that could work but are doing nothing useful right now, all teams together. Below the number: how many GPUs we track, and how many have no data (they may be wasted too, so they are never counted as zero).

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT sum(i.gpus) AS total,
         sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'IDLE') AS wasted,
         sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN') AS no_data
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN g.total > 0 THEN coalesce(g.wasted, 0) END AS "GPUs wasted now",
       CASE WHEN g.total IS NULL THEN 'nothing measured yet'
            ELSE 'of ' || to_char(g.total, 'FM999,999,990') || ' GPUs'
                 || CASE WHEN g.no_data > 0 THEN ' · ' || to_char(g.no_data, 'FM999,999,990') || ' have no data' ELSE '' END
       END AS label
FROM g

panels.title: GPU-hours wasted
panels.description: Wasted GPUs added up over the selected time range: one GPU wasted for one hour is one GPU-hour. 'At least' means part of the range is before our first scan, so the real number may be higher. Below it: GPU-hours we have no data for.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1,
         (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial')) AS first_scan
), iv AS (
  SELECT i.category,
         i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) - greatest(i.started_at, w.t0)) / 3600 AS gpu_h
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category IN ('IDLE', 'UNKNOWN') AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0
                         WHERE i0.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i0.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster)))
            THEN coalesce((SELECT sum(gpu_h) FROM iv WHERE category = 'IDLE'), 0) END AS "GPU-hours wasted",
       CASE WHEN w.first_scan IS NULL THEN 'nothing measured yet'
            WHEN w.first_scan > w.t0 THEN 'at least: no data before ' || to_char(w.first_scan AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY')
            ELSE 'in the selected period' END
       || CASE WHEN (SELECT sum(gpu_h) FROM iv WHERE category = 'UNKNOWN') >= 0.5
               THEN ' · ' || to_char((SELECT sum(gpu_h) FROM iv WHERE category = 'UNKNOWN'), 'FM999,999,990')
                    || ' GPU-hours have no data'
               WHEN (SELECT sum(gpu_h) FROM iv WHERE category = 'UNKNOWN') > 0
               THEN ' · under 1 GPU-hour has no data'
               ELSE '' END AS label
FROM w

panels.title: Cost of waste at AWS prices
panels.description: What the GPU-hours wasted in the selected range would cost. Money is what the same GPUs would cost to rent on AWS on-demand (us-east-1, at the AWS price list whose date is shown under the number): a comparison, not our bill. 'At least' means some of these GPUs have no AWS price (their model is not on the price list), so the real figure is higher; 'No price' means none of them has one. Neither is ever shown as 0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1,
         (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial')) AS first_scan
), snap AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id, s.region, coalesce(s.publication_date, s.captured_at) AS published
  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), p AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h), 0) AS gpu_h, sum(x.gpu_h * x.rate) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h) FILTER (WHERE x.rate IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced_h
  FROM (
    SELECT i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) - greatest(i.started_at, w.t0)) / 3600 AS gpu_h, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
    FROM capacity_intervals i
    CROSS JOIN w
    LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
    WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
  ) x
)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i0.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN NULL
            WHEN p.gpu_h = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.usd END AS "Cost of waste at AWS prices",
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN 'no AWS price list loaded'
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i0.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN 'nothing measured yet'
            ELSE concat_ws(' · ',
                   CASE WHEN p.usd IS NOT NULL AND (p.unpriced_h > 0 OR w.first_scan > w.t0) THEN 'at least' END,
                   CASE WHEN p.unpriced_h >= 0.5 THEN to_char(p.unpriced_h, 'FM999,999,990') || ' GPU-hours have no AWS price'
                        WHEN p.unpriced_h > 0 THEN 'under 1 GPU-hour has no AWS price' END,
                   CASE WHEN w.first_scan > w.t0
                        THEN 'no data before ' || to_char(w.first_scan AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY') END,
                   (SELECT 'AWS price list of ' || to_char(published AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY') || ' (' || region || ')' FROM snap))
       END AS label
FROM w CROSS JOIN p

panels.title: Costing now
panels.description: What the GPUs wasted right now cost per hour, and about how much per day if nothing changes. Money is what the same GPUs would cost to rent on AWS on-demand (us-east-1, at the AWS price list whose date is shown under the number): a comparison, not our bill. 'At least' means some of these GPUs have no AWS price (their model is not on the price list), so the real figure is higher; 'No price' means none of them has one. Neither is ever shown as 0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id, s.region, coalesce(s.publication_date, s.captured_at) AS published
  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), v AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(i.gpus), 0) AS gpus, sum(i.gpus * r.per_gpu_hour_usd) AS usd_h,
         coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN NULL
            WHEN v.gpus = 0 THEN 0 ELSE v.usd_h END AS "Costing now",
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN 'no AWS price list loaded'
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN 'nothing measured yet'
            ELSE concat_ws(' · ',
                   CASE WHEN v.gpus = 0 THEN 'nothing wasted now'
                        WHEN v.usd_h IS NOT NULL
                        THEN CASE WHEN v.unpriced > 0 THEN 'at least ' ELSE 'about ' END
                             || '$' || CASE WHEN v.usd_h * 24 >= 100 THEN to_char(v.usd_h * 24, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(v.usd_h * 24, 'FM990.00') END || ' a day' END,
                   CASE WHEN v.unpriced > 0 THEN to_char(v.unpriced, 'FM999,999,990') || ' wasted GPUs have no AWS price' END,
                   (SELECT 'AWS price list of ' || to_char(published AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'FMDD Mon YYYY') || ' (' || region || ')' FROM snap))
       END AS label
FROM v

panels.title: Where every GPU is now
panels.description: Every GPU we track, counted once. In use: running real work. Wasted: could work but is doing nothing useful. In repair: hardware being fixed, not waste. No data: we cannot see it right now, so it is never counted as zero waste. Not measured: in clusters we do not watch. Excluded: kept aside on purpose, such as labs and spares.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) AS "In use",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'IDLE'), 0) AS "Wasted",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'NOT_CHARGED' AND i.reason_code = 'MAINTENANCE'), 0) AS "In repair",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) AS "No data",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'NOT_CHARGED' AND i.reason_code = 'OUTSIDE_TARGET_CLUSTERS'), 0) AS "Not measured",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'NOT_CHARGED'
                                      AND i.reason_code NOT IN ('MAINTENANCE', 'OUTSIDE_TARGET_CLUSTERS')), 0) AS "Excluded"
FROM capacity_intervals i
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
HAVING count(*) > 0

panels.title: Data as of
panels.description: When the last scan finished. Every number on these pages is as of that scan. If it says more than 15 minutes ago, ask the platform team to check the scanner.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(finished_at)) * 1000 AS "Data as of"
FROM scan_runs
WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL

WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1,

  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), p AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h), 0) AS gpu_h, sum(x.gpu_h * x.rate) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h) FILTER (WHERE x.rate IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced_h
  FROM (
    SELECT i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) - greatest(i.started_at, w.t0)) / 3600 AS gpu_h, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
    FROM capacity_intervals i
    CROSS JOIN w
    LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
    WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'EMPTY' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
  ) x

  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN coalesce(sum(i.gpus), 0) END AS gpus

SELECT n.gpus AS "GPUs wasted now",
       'nothing on them' || CASE WHEN n.gpus IS NULL THEN ''
                         WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN ' · no AWS price list'

                         ELSE ' · ' || CASE WHEN p.unpriced_h > 0 OR w.first_scan > w.t0 THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                              || '$' || CASE WHEN p.usd >= 100 THEN to_char(p.usd, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(p.usd, 'FM990.00') END || ' in the period' END AS label
FROM n CROSS JOIN p CROSS JOIN w

       'models barely used' || CASE WHEN n.gpus IS NULL THEN ''
                         WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN ' · no AWS price list'
                         WHEN p.gpu_h = 0 THEN ' · nothing wasted in the period'
                         WHEN p.usd IS NULL THEN ' · no AWS price'
                         ELSE ' · ' || CASE WHEN p.unpriced_h > 0 OR w.first_scan > w.t0 THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                              || '$' || CASE WHEN p.usd >= 100 THEN to_char(p.usd, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(p.usd, 'FM990.00') END || ' in the period' END AS label
FROM n CROSS JOIN p CROSS JOIN w

panels.title: Machine Learning
panels.description: GPUs held by machine learning jobs that barely use them, or that do not start. Click to see every job. Below the number: what the team's wasted GPU-hours in the selected range would cost. That is what the same GPUs would cost to rent on AWS on-demand (us-east-1, at the AWS price list shown under 'Cost of waste at AWS prices'): a comparison, not our bill. '≥' means some of them have no AWS price.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1,
         (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial')) AS first_scan
), snap AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id, s.region, coalesce(s.publication_date, s.captured_at) AS published
  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), p AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h), 0) AS gpu_h, sum(x.gpu_h * x.rate) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(x.gpu_h) FILTER (WHERE x.rate IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced_h
  FROM (
    SELECT i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) - greatest(i.started_at, w.t0)) / 3600 AS gpu_h, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
    FROM capacity_intervals i
    CROSS JOIN w
    LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
    WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
  ) x
), n AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))) THEN coalesce(sum(i.gpus), 0) END AS gpus
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage = 'MACHINE_LEARNING' AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT n.gpus AS "GPUs wasted now",
       'jobs barely busy' || CASE WHEN n.gpus IS NULL THEN ''
                         WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN ' · no AWS price list'
                         WHEN p.gpu_h = 0 THEN ' · nothing wasted in the period'
                         WHEN p.usd IS NULL THEN ' · no AWS price'
                         ELSE ' · ' || CASE WHEN p.unpriced_h > 0 OR w.first_scan > w.t0 THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                              || '$' || CASE WHEN p.usd >= 100 THEN to_char(p.usd, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(p.usd, 'FM990.00') END || ' in the period' END AS label
FROM n CROSS JOIN p CROSS JOIN w

panels.title: GPUs wasted over time, by team
panels.description: Wasted GPUs over time, stacked by team. The dashed line is GPUs with no data; it belongs to no team and is not part of the stack. Nothing is drawn before our first scan.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()),
                         make_interval(secs => greatest($__interval_ms, 300000) / 1000.0)) AS t
), g AS (
  SELECT t.t FROM t
  WHERE t.t >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE kind = 'engine' AND status IN ('ok', 'partial'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 WHERE ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i0.cluster, i0.evidence ->> 'cluster', i0.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster)))
), teams (stage, ord, fallback) AS (
  VALUES ('EMPTY', 1, 'Samurai'),
         ('PROVISIONING', 2, 'Redbull'),
         ('GPU_PLATFORM', 3, 'POPAI'),
         ('SERVING', 4, 'Apply'),
         ('MACHINE_LEARNING', 5, 'Machine Learning')
), named AS (
  SELECT s.stage, s.ord, coalesce((SELECT o.stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals o WHERE o.stage = s.stage AND o.stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.started_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1), s.fallback) AS team
  FROM teams s
), iv AS (
  SELECT g.t, i.category, i.stage, i.gpus
  FROM g
  JOIN capacity_intervals i
    ON i.category IN ('IDLE', 'UNKNOWN') AND i.started_at <= g.t AND (i.ended_at IS NULL OR i.ended_at > g.t)
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
)
SELECT x.time, x.metric, x.value
FROM (
  SELECT g.t AS time, n.team AS metric, min(n.ord) AS ord, coalesce(sum(iv.gpus), 0) AS value
  FROM g
  CROSS JOIN named n
  LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.t = g.t AND iv.category = 'IDLE' AND iv.stage = n.stage
  GROUP BY g.t, n.team
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.t, 'No data', 99, coalesce(sum(iv.gpus), 0)
  FROM g
  LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.t = g.t AND iv.category = 'UNKNOWN'
  GROUP BY g.t
) x
ORDER BY x.time, x.ord

panels.title: GPUs by model now
panels.description: Every GPU we track, by GPU model, biggest fleet first, with the total in the last row. In use, wasted, in repair and no data add up to 'Where every GPU is now'; GPUs also counts the ones not measured or excluded. A model we cannot name shows as reported, or as 'Unknown model'. Money columns are what the same GPUs would cost to rent on AWS on-demand (us-east-1, at the AWS price list shown under 'Costing now'): a comparison, not our bill. '≥' means part of it has no AWS price; 'no AWS price' means none of it has one.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT s.snapshot_id, s.region, coalesce(s.publication_date, s.captured_at) AS published
  FROM pricing_snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
  ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST,
           s.captured_at DESC, s.snapshot_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), c AS (
  SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(ga.canonical, nullif(i.gpu_model, ''), 'Unknown model'), '^NVIDIA ', '') AS model,
         i.category, i.reason_code, i.gpus, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = (SELECT snapshot_id FROM snap) AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($cluster) OR coalesce(i.cluster, i.evidence ->> 'cluster', i.evidence ->> 'cluster_name', '(no cluster)') IN ($cluster))
), m AS (
  SELECT c.model, false AS total, max(c.rate) AS rate,
         sum(c.gpus) AS gpus,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) AS in_use,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'IDLE'), 0) AS wasted,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'NOT_CHARGED' AND c.reason_code = 'MAINTENANCE'), 0) AS repair,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) AS no_data,
         sum(c.gpus * c.rate) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'IDLE') AS wasted_usd_h,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'IDLE' AND c.rate IS NULL), 0) AS wasted_unpriced
  FROM c GROUP BY c.model
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'All models', true, NULL,
         sum(c.gpus) AS gpus,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) AS in_use,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'IDLE'), 0) AS wasted,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'NOT_CHARGED' AND c.reason_code = 'MAINTENANCE'), 0) AS repair,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) AS no_data,
         sum(c.gpus * c.rate) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'IDLE') AS wasted_usd_h,
         coalesce(sum(c.gpus) FILTER (WHERE c.category = 'IDLE' AND c.rate IS NULL), 0) AS wasted_unpriced
  FROM c HAVING count(*) > 0
)
SELECT m.model AS "Model",
       m.gpus AS "GPUs",
       m.in_use AS "In use",
       m.wasted AS "Wasted",
       m.repair AS "In repair",
       m.no_data AS "No data",
       100.0 * m.wasted / m.gpus AS "Wasted share",
       CASE WHEN m.total THEN NULL
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN 'no price list'
            WHEN m.rate IS NULL THEN 'no AWS price'
            ELSE '$' || CASE WHEN m.rate >= 100 THEN to_char(m.rate, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(m.rate, 'FM990.00') END END AS "AWS price per GPU-hour",
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snap) THEN 'no price list'
            WHEN m.wasted = 0 AND (m.total OR m.rate IS NOT NULL) THEN '$' || '0.00'
            WHEN m.wasted_usd_h IS NULL THEN 'no AWS price'
            ELSE CASE WHEN m.wasted_unpriced > 0 THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || '$' || CASE WHEN m.wasted_usd_h >= 100 THEN to_char(m.wasted_usd_h, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(m.wasted_usd_h, 'FM990.00') END
       END AS "Wasted, costing per hour at AWS prices"
FROM m
ORDER BY m.total, m.gpus DESC, m.model
